45844247872.text:
Location: Waterford, Ireland
Start date: January 2027
Duration: 4 to 6 months
Work Model: onsite
About the job
As a Sustainability & Facilities Intern , you will support ongoing projects that help ensure the reliable supply of critical utilities across the site while contributing to engineering, compliance, and sustainability initiatives. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment while working with experienced professionals across facilities and engineering teams.
About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
Main responsibilities:
Support the monitoring and analysis of clean utility systems, including water, steam, and compressed gases.
Help collect, organise, and interpret energy and water consumption data to support sustainability objectives.
Assist with the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and presentations for internal stakeholders.
Participate in continuous improvement projects focused on reducing the environmental impact of utility operations.
Contribute to the review and update of standard operating procedures and technical specifications.
Support audit and inspection readiness activities by organising and maintaining relevant documentation.
Attend team meetings and cross-functional workshops, documenting key actions and supporting follow-up activities.
About you
To excel in this role, you will need to:
Be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
Have a basic understanding of engineering, chemistry, or environmental science principles and an interest in sustainability and utilities operations.
Be comfortable reading and interpreting technical data and process documentation.
Demonstrate strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a structured environment.
Be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal, as English is the working language of the team.
Be curious, eager to learn, and able to work both independently and collaboratively within a team.
It would be advantageous if you have:
Experience in a laboratory, manufacturing, or industrial environment through projects, placements, or previous internships.
Knowledge of water treatment, HVAC, or utility systems.
Familiarity with sustainability frameworks, environmental regulations, or regulated environments such as GMP.
Experience using data analysis or data visualisation tools such as Power BI.
Why choose us?
Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.
Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.
Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.
Explore more with personalized development plans, short-term gigs, and internal mobility across functions and countries.
Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives.
Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.
Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications.
#LI-EUR #LI-Onsite

46668769728.text:
Location: Waterford, Ireland
Start Date: 1 September 2027
Duration: 23 months | Two 8-month rotations, and 7-month
Working Model: on-site
Working Hours: Full-time
Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford
Your opportunity at Sanofi
Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience?
Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 23-month Graduate Programme in Waterford . Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career.
Our engineers are at the heart of bringing innovative medicines to patients, solving complex challenges and driving continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. This programme offers a unique opportunity to explore different engineering disciplines, contribute to real projects and develop the skills and experience needed to become a future engineering leader.
One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience.
Why explore just one area when you could experience three?
Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through two 8-month rotations, and 7-month , providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals.
Your rotation journey
Rotation 1: Engineering | Months 1–8
Start your journey in Engineering, where you'll gain an understanding of the technical infrastructure and systems that enable a world-class biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility to operate safely, efficiently and reliably. Working alongside engineering teams, you'll develop practical knowledge of equipment, utilities, maintenance and continuous improvement practices that support the delivery of medicines to patients worldwide.
Gain hands-on experience across Engineering functions including Maintenance, Projects and Utilities.
Support equipment reliability and preventive maintenance activities, helping to ensure safe and efficient manufacturing operations.
Contribute to troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges and enhance process performance.
Rotation 2: Operations | Months 9–16
Build on your engineering foundation by moving into Operations, where you'll gain first-hand experience of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and learn how products are produced in a highly regulated GMP environment. You'll work closely with manufacturing teams to understand the processes, systems and controls that ensure the safe and reliable supply of medicines to patients.
Support batch execution and day-to-day manufacturing activities within a GMP-regulated environment.
Develop an understanding of manufacturing processes, SOPs, quality requirements and operational excellence principles.
Gain exposure to Quality, Supply Chain and other site functions, building an understanding of how different teams collaborate to ensure reliable product delivery.
Rotation 3: Engineering Projects & Validation | Months 17–23
Complete your graduate journey in Engineering Projects and Validation, where you'll apply the technical and operational knowledge gained throughout the programme while contributing to projects that support site expansion, equipment implementation and regulatory compliance. You'll gain valuable experience managing complex initiatives and ensuring systems and equipment are fit for their intended use in a regulated environment.
Support engineering projects from planning through execution, collaborating with internal stakeholders and external vendors to deliver project objectives safely, on time and within scope.
Participate in qualification and validation activities, including commissioning, IQ/OQ/PQ execution, documentation review and compliance with GMP requirements.
Contribute to continuous improvement, technology implementation and facility enhancement projects while developing project management, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills.
Your development focus
Throughout the programme, you'll develop the technical, operational and leadership skills needed to build a successful career in Engineering within a biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
Develop a strong understanding of manufacturing operations, engineering systems and GMP-regulated processes.
Build problem-solving, project management and cross-functional collaboration skills by working with teams across Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain and MSAT.
Gain hands-on experience in continuous improvement, equipment reliability, troubleshooting and operational excellence, while developing the confidence to lead initiatives and drive meaningful business outcomes.
Your growth, our commitment
Your development is at the heart of our programme. Here's what you can look forward to:
Three diverse rotations: Explore different functions and build a broader understanding of the business.
Dedicated cross-functional mentor: Receive guidance from an assigned mentor, with monthly check-ins throughout the programme.
A buddy in every rotation: Get practical, day-to-day support as you settle into each new team.
Hands-on training: Learn directly from experienced colleagues and develop skills through practical experience and training opportunities.
Who we're looking for
We're looking for curious, motivated graduates who are eager to learn, collaborate and explore new opportunities.
To be eligible, you'll need to:
Have graduated within the past two years or be due to graduate before 1 September 2027.
Hold a minimum 2.1 primary degree or a Master's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related discipline.
Have full, unrestricted right to work in Ireland.
Essential skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical solutions.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive mindset, demonstrating curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to learn within a regulated manufacturing environment.
Desirable qualifications
Relevant internship, co-op placement, university project or work experience within Engineering, Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device or related industries.
Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma or Operational Excellence principles.
Familiarity with engineering systems, maintenance practices or manufacturing processes within a regulated environment.
Experience using data analysis and reporting tools, with a good understanding of Microsoft Excel and other technical software packages.
Previous experience through internships, placements or relevant work is an advantage, but not essential.
About Sanofi
We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world.
Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
What we offer
Alongside structured professional development, you'll receive:
Annual salary: €41,600 gross per annum
Bonus: Performance related bonus 8% (STI)
Benefits: Access to an attractive benefits package.
Your recruitment journey
We want you to know what to expect at every step:
Apply & complete a short survey: After applying, you'll receive a mandatory screening survey.
On-demand video interview: Selected candidates can record their responses at a convenient time within the given deadline.
Short connect call: An informal conversation with our recruitment team to discuss your application and confirm a few details.
In-person assessment centre: Final assessments are planned for January 2027 at our Waterford site .
Candidates will be assessed at each stage, with Progression to the next step depending on the outcome. Further details will be shared with those progressing.
Ready to start your journey?
You don't need to have your whole career figured out. If you're curious, eager to learn and excited to explore what the pharmaceutical industry has to offer, we'd love to hear from you.
Three rotations. Two years. Your future starts here.
Apply now and start your journey with Sanofi!

#LI-Onsite

Develop expertise in automation and control systems, including PLCs, SCADA, HMI platforms, and GMP-compliant computerised systems.
Build strong project management, problem-solving, collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills through cross-functional assignments and project work.
Gain practical experience in digital transformation, data-driven decision-making, system lifecycle management, and the implementation of Industry 4.0 technologies within a regulated manufacturing environment.

To be eligible, you'll need to:

Hold a minimum 2.1 primary degree or a Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering or technology discipline .

Essential skills:
Strong interest in automation, digital technologies, and advanced manufacturing environments.
Basic understanding of industrial automation systems, control systems, programming, or computer networking.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work successfully in cross-functional teams.

47166505600.text:
Über die Stelle
Dein Start ins Management – Leadership Traineeprogramm
Stell dir vor, dein erster Job nach dem Studium ist nicht irgendein Einstieg, sondern der Startpunkt für eine echte Führungslaufbahn – mit Einblick in Entscheidungen, die zählen und Menschen, die dich dabei fordern und fördern.
Der Sanofi BioCampus in Frankfurt ist einer der größten integrierten Produktionsstandorte des weltweit tätigen Gesundheitsunternehmens Sanofi. Hier entstehen moderne Arzneimittel wie Biologika und Insuline für den Weltmarkt.
Der Bereich Manufacturing & Supply innerhalb des Sanofi BioCampus umfasst die Wirkstoffproduktion, die Sterilabfüllung, die Fertigung sowie die Bereiche Development, Qualitätssicherung und Engineering – ein riesiges Spielfeld für alle, die mehr wollen als nur einen Job. Unsere Führungskräfte von morgen gestalten die Zukunft aktiv mit – mit Verantwortung für Menschen, Ergebnisse und strategische Weiterentwicklung.
Mit dem Leadership Traineeprogramm legst du den Grundstein für deine Zukunft als Führungskraft in Manufacturing & Supply. Es ist genau richtig für dich, wenn du deine Expertise als Basis nutzen möchtest, um mittelfristig Menschen zu begeistern, Teams zu entwickeln und strategische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte richte diese bis zum
15. Januar 2027 ausschließlich elektronisch an unseren Partner Provadis unter Bewerbungsformular .
Das erwartet dich
Dein Einstieg mit Fokus auf Leadership: Start in der bio-pharmazeutischen Produktion zum 1. Mai 2027 mit klarem Fokus auf deine Entwicklung zur zukünftigen Führungskraft
Vielseitige Einblicke: Lerne verschiedene Bereiche (z. B. Produktion, Engineering, Bioprozesstechnik, Projektmanagement, Operational Excellence) an einem innovativen Pharmastandort kennen
Spannende Projekte: Wir binden dich in interdisziplinäre und teilweise globale Projekte ein
Strategie hautnah: Arbeite an Aufgabenstellungen strategischer Natur mit und erhalte Einblicke in Entscheidungsprozesse des Managements
Dein persönliches Leadership-Development-Programm: Neben Trainings bieten wir dir Coaching und Mentoring durch erfahrene Führungskräfte
Sinn, der bleibt: Trage dazu bei, dass lebenswichtige Medikamente dort ankommen, wo sie gebraucht werden
Nie allein: ein kompetentes Team, das dich begleitet und unterstützt
Wachstum, das man spürt: ein innovatives Qualifizierungsprogramm, das dich fachlich und persönlich wirklich weiterbringt
Was wir dir bieten
Einblick in Leadership: Du lernst, wie man Menschen mitnimmt und strategisch Einfluss nimmt.
Talent-Entwicklung: Vielfältige Möglichkeiten nach dem Programm, deine Karriere voranzutreiben, sei es durch eine Beförderung oder einen Quereinstieg, im Inland oder international
Orientierung: Begleitung bei deiner beruflichen Entwicklung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie
Gute Absicherung: ein breites Spektrum an Gesundheits- und Sozialleistungen, unter anderem eine hochwertige Gesundheitsversorgung sowie Präventionsprogramme
Flexibilität, die zum Leben passt: je nach Einsatzbereich und innerhalb Deutschlands eine attraktive Mobile Office Policy
Über Dich
Fachlich:
Einen überdurchschnittlichen Masterabschluss in einem ingenieurtechnischen Studiengang wie z.B. Maschinenbau, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, und Wirtschaftswissenschaften/Informatik, gegebenenfalls mit Promotion
Studienschwerpunkte können z.B. Mess- und Regeltechnik/Prozessleittechnik, Robotik, Data Engineering, Digitales Management oder Projektmanagement sein
Erste praktische Erfahrungen in einem Pharma- oder Biotechunternehmen sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
Erste Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination von Teams, zum Beispiel im Sportverein, studentischen Initiativen oder ähnliches sind von Vorteil
Persönlich:
Du möchtest Prozesse und Technik nicht nur verstehen, sondern aktiv mitentwickeln – inklusive dem Projektmanagement dahinter
Du möchtest mittelfristig Leadership-Verantwortung übernehmen und bringst daher die klare Ambition mit, Menschen zu fördern und zu entwickeln, Teams zu leiten und Verantwortung für wirkungsvolle Ergebnisse zu übernehmen
Strategisches Denken auf Basis datenbasierter Analysen
Du möchtest KI-gestützte Prozesse und Automatisierung nicht nur nutzen, sondern auch aktiv vorantreiben
Du kannst komplexe Themen so erklären, dass sie jeder versteht – und denkst dabei analytisch und konzeptionell stark
Du kannst Entscheidungen treffen, auch wenn noch nicht alle Infos zur Verfügung stehen
Interdisziplinäre Teams sind für dich kein Kompromiss, sondern genau dein Element
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch – schriftlich wie mündlich
Veränderungen sind für dich eine Chance, und du bleibst auch in herausfordernden Phasen belastbar
Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und stehst für deine Entscheidungen ein
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung bis zum 15. Januar 2027 .
Bitte nutze ausschließlich dieses Bewerbungsformular .
Einladung zum virtuellen Meet & Greet
Weitere Informationen gibt es z. B. beim virtuellen Meet & Greet am Montag, 14. Dezember 2026 von 14:00 bis 16:00 Uhr . Zur Anmeldung schick uns eine formlose Nachricht an traineeprogramme@provadis.de

Location: Amsterdam
Start date: February 2027
Duration: 6 month
Work Model: full-time, Hybrid (3 days per week in the office, with Monday and Tuesday mandatory; the third office day is flexible).
About the job
As a Market Access Intern – Health Economics & Policy Research, you will join our Market Access Netherlands team and contribute to a research project exploring how healthcare systems evaluate and reimburse innovative medicines. You will look into how cost-effectiveness assessment frameworks are applied in the Netherlands and other European countries, and how these frameworks shape patient access to new therapies over time.
Working alongside experienced market access and health economics professionals, you will combine scientific literature reviews, policy analysis, and economic data to develop evidence-based insights. Your research could contribute to a scientific publication or policy paper, giving you the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to discussions about healthcare policy and patient access to innovation.
Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.
Main responsibilities:
Conduct a structured review of scientific research and policy publications on healthcare cost-effectiveness assessment frameworks in the Netherlands and other European countries, such as the UK, Sweden, and Germany.
Explore how reimbursement assessment criteria have evolved over time in relation to changing healthcare costs and economic conditions.
Investigate how assessment frameworks influence reimbursement decisions and patient access to innovative medicines.
Analyse publicly available reimbursement decisions and economic data to identify trends and draw insights.
Translate research findings into a structured scientific manuscript or policy paper, with the potential for publication.
Present your findings and recommendations to the Market Access team and relevant internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with colleagues and, where relevant, external experts, academic partners, or patient organisations to validate research findings.
About you
To excel in this role you will need to have:
Currently pursuing a Master's degree, ideally approaching graduation, in Health Economics, Health Policy, Epidemiology, Pharmacy, Economics, or a related field.
Good understanding of health technology assessment, cost-effectiveness analysis, and healthcare decision-making, including quality-adjusted life years (QALYs).
Experience with academic research, scientific literature reviews, and evaluating information from different sources.
